description: The app's secret login key, for apps that already have their own users ("Tu propio login" in neblla_get_llms({ section: "identidad" })). Their server calls POST https://neblla.com/api/apps/<appId>/auth/token with Authorization: Bearer <key> and { externalId, email?, emailVerified?, name? }, gets a one-use token valid one minute, and the front calls neblla.auth.login({ token }). action "create" makes the key (refused if one exists), "rotate" replaces it (the old one stops working at once), "revoke" removes it. The key is returned only by create and rotate. Whoever has it can sign in as any user of this app, like a Stripe key, so it belongs in the server's environment and not in the app's code. The actions that only look (status) are in neblla_auth_secret_read.
name: neblla_auth_secret
title: Auth secret
